outline: The objective of this course is to teach students how to make smart financial decisions in an effort to create most economical investment return. This course focuses on identification of investment projects, investment decision-making, project analysis and evaluation methods. The subjects includes: the investment environment, cost concepts and behaviors, understanding financial statements, investment project evaluation, interest rate and inflation rate, own - and debt financing, internal and external financing, depreciation, income taxes, developing project cash flows, capital budgeting, uncertainty and risk. Various factors that affect the financial decision problems such as economics, management, environment, and politics are discussed to help decision makers properly resolve investment decisions.
